sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 4 skills from your past — check your Journal.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Nolan Lynch. Community gardener. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Trail compass, Contract Quill, Knife roll, Mixtape, Dog tags. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. They found a deer this
A person, maybe 30s: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
FLASHBACK — before the scattering, there was an incident. People who knew you then use careful words about it now. You remember it differently than they do. You remember it clearly.
Nolan remembers the extra portion you gave you two weeks ago the way a banker remembers a loan. The reminder always comes with a smile and a small, specific ask.
People will notice: keeps mental score of every kindness, and collects on them. Let them. It's useful, being underestimated — or feared.

INNER VOICE: the others are already afraid. Fear is a kind of respect that doesn't ask for anything back. You could build something here — not on trust. On what people will do to stay on your good side. (Corruption starts at 20. The slope is yours to walk — or not.)
